body.statement: Using \(\text{def:q-lower-handle}\), prove that for every \(\eta>0\) no algorithm solves the supplied-order \(\textsc{K-Fiber}\) problem in \((2-\eta)^{q_\pi}\operatorname{poly}(N,K)\) time under the primal-pathwidth SETH, on rational covariances faithful to no-collider forests, or exhibit a strictly smaller sufficient state that refutes the proposed base-two frontier. A lower-bound construction may invoke \(\text{thm:rational-tree-realization}\) only after its piecewise diagonal and off-diagonal formula has been certified through the arbitrary-root SEM covariance identity, both directed residuals on every edge, positive definiteness, nonzero-edge faithfulness, rationality, polynomial bit length, and exact preservation of the crossing-label set.
body.justification: This exposes the true open content behind the natural subset-state algorithm rather than presenting its upper bound as optimal by analogy.
body.gap: Lampis2025 proves base-two barriers for Set Cover incidence pathwidth, not for numerical residual labels whose Gaussian realization may create extra crossing values.
body.consumer: The lower bound certifies when reordering components, rather than improving the state base, is the only route to faster exact analysis.

obligation.what_is_open: Either certify the claimed \((2-\eta)^{q_\pi}\) lower bound under primal-pathwidth SETH on faithful rational Gaussian forests, with exact crossing-label preservation, or exhibit a smaller sufficient state than the live subset and completed-label count.
obligation.obstruction: An incidence-pathwidth Set Cover gadget has not been compiled into rational tree signatures without private realization labels crossing a cut or unintended roots discharging obligations cheaply. The inverse-realization equations also force paired directed residual ratios and rational-square constraints, so an abstract set-system lower bound does not transfer by label renaming.
obligation.attempted: The full \((K+1)2^{q_\pi}\) right-congruence upper bound was proved, including exact multiplicity. Candidate star and varying-center realizations were checked symbolically; the former admits a universal witness and the latter incurs complementary labels. No collision-free Gaussian compatibility gadget or smaller exact state emerged.
obligation.partial_result: For every supplied order, the exact live-label right congruence gives an upper bound of \((K+1)2^{q_\pi}\operatorname{poly}(N)\) bit operations for decision, uniqueness, and two-witness recovery.  The rational-tree realization theorem gives necessary and sufficient algebraic tests for compiling abstract recurring-label gadgets.  No certified reduction currently proves that all \(2^{q_\pi}\) live subsets are necessary on faithful rational Gaussian forest instances, and no smaller sufficient right-congruence state has been derived.
